programme.title: They Call Him OG
programme.desc: An ex-mob boss resurfaces in Mumbai's underworld after a decade, hellbent on seeking revenge against the rival crime lords.

programme.title: Himmatwala
programme.desc: After being humiliated by an autocratic landlord, a temple priest kills himself. Later, the priest's son returns to the village seeking revenge.

programme.title: Fillers
programme.desc: A comprehensive compilation of promotional videos and trailers of Bollywood movies featuring popular actors is played sequentially.

programme.title: Bal Hanuman Return Of The Demon
programme.desc: Bal Hanuman and his friends join together to defeat the crocodile demon who has been brought to life in order to create havoc on Earth.

programme.title: Darwaza Bandh Rakho
programme.desc: Four men take refuge in a family's house after they kidnap a wealthy young girl.

programme.title: Bhuj: The Pride of India
programme.desc: During the Indo-Pakistani War, IAF squadron leader Vijay Karnik reconstructs a damaged landing strip in 72 hours with the help of local women.

programme.title: Chhichhore
programme.desc: Following a group of friends from university as they progress into middle-age life and go their own separate ways.

programme.title: Bhoothnath
programme.desc: A rhythmic exchange of silly pranks and shenanigans begins after a little boy and his family move into a house inhabited by a grumpy old ghost.

programme.title: Stree2 - Sarkate Ka Aatank
programme.desc: In the town of Chanderi, a headless spirit begins to abduct women. Vicky and his friends unite to resolve the mystery and save everyone from the threat.

programme.title: Bhool Bhulaiyaa
programme.desc: An Indian man living in the US decides to visit his hometown with his new wife and, despite his family's advice, they insist on staying at the ancestral home.

programme.title: Dhurandhar
programme.desc: An underworld saga following a network of criminals, informants and operatives whose lives intersect, navigating covert operations, espionage and betrayals.

programme.title: Mega Star God Father
programme.desc: A political leader's death leads to a power struggle. Amid corruption, greed and deceit, an unlikely opponent steps up.

programme.title: Gods of Egypt
programme.desc: After Set, the Egyptian God of darkness, kills his brother and seizes the throne, he enslaves the kingdom. However, a flawed mortal, Bek, and the God of the sky Horus rise to challenge him.

programme.title: Johnny English
programme.desc: Pascal Sauvage (John Malkovich), a villain intent on stealing Britain's Crown Jewels, has murdered the country's top undercover agents, and mediocre spy Johnny English (Rowan Atkinson) is ordered to prevent further mayhem. But even with help from quick-thinking sidekick Bough (Ben Miller), the goofy agent lands himself in one precarious situation after another. Only when he meets up with Interpol crime-fighter Lorna Campbell (Natalie Imbruglia) is Johnny able to chip away at Pascal's defenses.

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: When North Korean troops invade U.S. soil and take over the city of Spokane, Wash., a recently returned Iraq War veteran and a group of teens flee to the woods and form a band of freedom fighters. Dubbing themselves the Wolverines, the youths launch guerrilla attacks against the invaders, but how long they can sustain the fight in the face of the enemy's superior numbers and firepower remains in question.

programme.title: The Pilgrim
programme.desc: A convict escapes from prison and guises as a pastor to save himself from the sheriff. The sheriff cannot be outsmarted and is determined to take him into custody.

programme.title: The LEGO Movie 2: The Second Part
programme.desc: Five years after saving the Lego world, Emmet must once again save everyone with the help of Rex Dangervest when new enemies from outer space attack them.

programme.title: Ghost Rider: Spirit of Vengeance
programme.desc: Now hiding out in Eastern Europe, Johnny Blaze (Nicolas Cage) is still struggling with the curse of the Ghost Rider -- the devil's bounty hunter. Johnny meets a priest named Moreau (Idris Elba), who asks Johnny to find a boy named Danny (Fergus Riordan) and bring him back. But there's a catch -- Satan (Ciarán Hinds) is looking for the boy too, and has a personal stake in the matter. But if Johnny can find Danny first and save the boy's soul, there's a chance Johnny can save his own soul as well.

programme.title: Gods of Egypt
programme.desc: After Set, the Egyptian God of darkness, kills his brother and seizes the throne, he enslaves the kingdom. However, a flawed mortal, Bek, and the God of the sky Horus rise to challenge him.

programme.title: Spider-Man
programme.desc: "Spider-Man" centers on student Peter Parker (Tobey Maguire) who, after being bitten by a genetically-altered spider, gains superhuman strength and the spider-like ability to cling to any surface. He vows to use his abilities to fight crime, coming to understand the words of his beloved Uncle Ben: "With great power comes great responsibility."

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: After an epic battle, a great city lies in ruins, but the Earth itself is saved. As humanity begins to pick up the pieces, a shadowy group emerges to try to take control of history. Meanwhile, an ancient and powerful new menace sets its sights on Earth. A new group of humans, led by Cade Yeager (Mark Wahlberg), helps Optimus Prime (Peter Cullen) and the Autobots rise up to meet their most fearsome challenge yet: a worldwide war of good versus evil.

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: In this sequel set eleven years after "The Terminator," young John Connor (Edward Furlong), the key to civilization's victory over a future robot uprising, is the target of the shape-shifting T-1000 (Robert Patrick), a Terminator sent from the future to kill him. Another Terminator, the revamped T-800 (Arnold Schwarzenegger), has been sent back to protect the boy. As John and his mother (Linda Hamilton) go on the run with the T-800, the boy forms an unexpected bond with the robot.

programme.title: Wicked
programme.desc: Elphaba and Glinda, polar opposites, become friends at Shiz University. Later, their relationship faces a crucial test when Elphaba defies The Wizard of Oz, altering both of their destinies.

programme.title: The Lost City
programme.desc: Loretta Sage, a novelist of ancient tombs and daring quests, faces real-life peril when abducted by an eccentric billionaire seeking a mythical lost city. Meanwhile, Alan, her attractive book cover model, launches a clumsy rescue attempt. Together, they navigate jungle dangers and interpersonal conflicts to unearth the fabled treasure before it vanishes forever.

programme.title: Fast & Furious Presents: Hobbs & Shaw
programme.desc: Luke Hobbs and Deckard Shaw set aside their differences and team up to protect the world from Brixton, a formidable adversary.

programme.title: The Angry Birds Movie
programme.desc: Red, Chuck and Bomb have always been the outcasts within a community of flightless birds on an island. But when mysterious green pigs intrude the island, it is up to them to figure out the reason.

programme.desc: You won't hear the phrase "free shipping" uttered in this real-life series. It follows heavy-duty movers as they battle for the chance to transport items that traditional carriers won't touch, from bulky loads such as a Civil War cannon to bizarre items like a water buffalo. programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Dual Survival
programme.desc: Surviving in the wild is not an exact science. Beyond the basics of finding water, food, shelter and eventually help, opinions vary. Two experts tell how they think it's done in this series, as initial episodes feature trained survivalists Dave Canterbury and Cody Lundin demonstrating the skills and creative thinking that can help one cope in tough surroundings. Equipped with minimal gear, the pair are left in remote locations -- an uninhabited island off Nova Scotia, a New Zealand mountaintop, deep in the Everglades, the jungle of Thailand, and the desert of Baja California, to name a few -- where they battle the elements and sometimes each other. Season 3 introduces U.S. Special Ops veteran Joseph Teti to replace Canterbury, in the middle of Season 4 primitive survivalist Matt Graham of Discovery's "Dude, You're Screwed" replaces Lundin, and partway through Season 5 producers forge new partnerships by rotating survival experts as hosts.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Dual Survival
programme.desc: Surviving in the wild is not an exact science. Beyond the basics of finding water, food, shelter and eventually help, opinions vary. Two experts tell how they think it's done in this series, as initial episodes feature trained survivalists Dave Canterbury and Cody Lundin demonstrating the skills and creative thinking that can help one cope in tough surroundings. Equipped with minimal gear, the pair are left in remote locations -- an uninhabited island off Nova Scotia, a New Zealand mountaintop, deep in the Everglades, the jungle of Thailand, and the desert of Baja California, to name a few -- where they battle the elements and sometimes each other. Season 3 introduces U.S. Special Ops veteran Joseph Teti to replace Canterbury, in the middle of Season 4 primitive survivalist Matt Graham of Discovery's "Dude, You're Screwed" replaces Lundin, and partway through Season 5 producers forge new partnerships by rotating survival experts as hosts.

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: With one quick click the internet allows people to share information like family photos and professional accomplishments, making it easy to ignore or forget that behind clever screen names and witty captions is a dark digital world with real dangers and risks. In hourlong episodes, Web of Lies unravels tragic stories of deception and manipulation triggered by online interactions, from predators lurking behind Facebook profiles to creeps scouring chat rooms for their victims. Re-enactments are buttressed by comments from law enforcement personnel, true-crime experts and psychologists, plus first-person accounts from friends and families of the victims.

This series, narrated by actress Brenda Strong, explores families hiding the most extreme of family secrets: murder. programme.desc: Featured on the Destination America series "Ghost Asylum," the Tennessee Wraith Chasers take their specter-hunting skills on the road to investigate America's most haunted towns. The team -- founder Chris Smith, co-founder Steven McDougal, historian Scott Porter, and trap inventor Brannon Smith -- travels to paranormal hotspots like Salem, Mass., Bisbee, Ariz., and Gettysburg, Pa., to interview witnesses and follow leads to try to pinpoint who is haunting the towns and why. Spooky stories in such places have been passed down through generations. Is it simply folklore, or is it true?

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The forest ranger's house is the only area of human civilization in the middle of untamed wilderness in a vast natural reserve in Canada. When the ranger is away, a bear named Grizzy feels that the ranger's house is his territory, given that bears sit at the top of the food chain. After making his way inside the home, Grizzy takes advantage of all the modern conveniences there, including a comfortable sofa, air conditioning and fully equipped kitchen. He's not alone, though, because a group of small creatures called lemmings also populate the ranger's house when he is away. Because Grizzy and the lemmings are not civilized enough to live together in peace, it becomes an atmosphere of madness when the two sides try to outdo each other with tricks.

programme.title: We Bare Bears
programme.desc: Three brother bears awkwardly attempt to find their place in civilized society, whether they're looking for food, trying to make human friends, or scheming to become famous on the internet. Grizzly, Panda and Ice Bear stack atop one another when they leave their cave and explore the hipster environs of the San Francisco Bay Area, and it's clear the siblings have a lot to learn about a technologically driven world. By their side on many adventures are best friend Chloe (the only human character in the cast), fame-obsessed panda Nom Nom, and Charlie, aka Bigfoot.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The forest ranger's house is the only area of human civilization in the middle of untamed wilderness in a vast natural reserve in Canada. When the ranger is away, a bear named Grizzy feels that the ranger's house is his territory, given that bears sit at the top of the food chain. After making his way inside the home, Grizzy takes advantage of all the modern conveniences there, including a comfortable sofa, air conditioning and fully equipped kitchen. He's not alone, though, because a group of small creatures called lemmings also populate the ranger's house when he is away. Because Grizzy and the lemmings are not civilized enough to live together in peace, it becomes an atmosphere of madness when the two sides try to outdo each other with tricks.

programme.title: Food Factory
programme.desc: Food Network Canada presents this eye-opening series featuring food factories. Each episode offers a behind-the-scenes view of production lines across the country to find out how some of the most-popular food items are really made. Through the ingredients, techniques and required processes, "Food Factory" reveals how raw ingredients are turned into everyday eats. In what some call a fascinating world, the manufacturing and technology that is being used in factories simplifies how the country gets its food.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Dual Survival
programme.desc: Surviving in the wild is not an exact science. Beyond the basics of finding water, food, shelter and eventually help, opinions vary. Two experts tell how they think it's done in this series, as initial episodes feature trained survivalists Dave Canterbury and Cody Lundin demonstrating the skills and creative thinking that can help one cope in tough surroundings. Equipped with minimal gear, the pair are left in remote locations -- an uninhabited island off Nova Scotia, a New Zealand mountaintop, deep in the Everglades, the jungle of Thailand, and the desert of Baja California, to name a few -- where they battle the elements and sometimes each other. Season 3 introduces U.S. Special Ops veteran Joseph Teti to replace Canterbury, in the middle of Season 4 primitive survivalist Matt Graham of Discovery's "Dude, You're Screwed" replaces Lundin, and partway through Season 5 producers forge new partnerships by rotating survival experts as hosts.

programme.desc: You won't hear the phrase "free shipping" uttered in this real-life series. programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. programme.title: Dual Survival
programme.desc: Surviving in the wild is not an exact science. Beyond the basics of finding water, food, shelter and eventually help, opinions vary. Two experts tell how they think it's done in this series, as initial episodes feature trained survivalists Dave Canterbury and Cody Lundin demonstrating the skills and creative thinking that can help one cope in tough surroundings. Equipped with minimal gear, the pair are left in remote locations -- an uninhabited island off Nova Scotia, a New Zealand mountaintop, deep in the Everglades, the jungle of Thailand, and the desert of Baja California, to name a few -- where they battle the elements and sometimes each other. Season 3 introduces U.S. Special Ops veteran Joseph Teti to replace Canterbury, in the middle of Season 4 primitive survivalist Matt Graham of Discovery's "Dude, You're Screwed" replaces Lundin, and partway through Season 5 producers forge new partnerships by rotating survival experts as hosts.

Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.desc: You won't hear the phrase "free shipping" uttered in this real-life series. It follows heavy-duty movers as they battle for the chance to transport items that traditional carriers won't touch, from bulky loads such as a Civil War cannon to bizarre items like a water buffalo. When he sees a vehicle he wants, whether it's at an auto auction or at a roadside diner, Koker does all he can to acquire it. When successful, he and his team then work to restore and modify the cars and motorcycles to quickly flip them for a profit. programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. programme.title: Dual Survival
programme.desc: Surviving in the wild is not an exact science. Beyond the basics of finding water, food, shelter and eventually help, opinions vary. Two experts tell how they think it's done in this series, as initial episodes feature trained survivalists Dave Canterbury and Cody Lundin demonstrating the skills and creative thinking that can help one cope in tough surroundings. Equipped with minimal gear, the pair are left in remote locations -- an uninhabited island off Nova Scotia, a New Zealand mountaintop, deep in the Everglades, the jungle of Thailand, and the desert of Baja California, to name a few -- where they battle the elements and sometimes each other. Season 3 introduces U.S. Special Ops veteran Joseph Teti to replace Canterbury, in the middle of Season 4 primitive survivalist Matt Graham of Discovery's "Dude, You're Screwed" replaces Lundin, and partway through Season 5 producers forge new partnerships by rotating survival experts as hosts.

programme.title: We Bare Bears
programme.desc: Three brother bears awkwardly attempt to find their place in civilized society, whether they're looking for food, trying to make human friends, or scheming to become famous on the internet. Grizzly, Panda and Ice Bear stack atop one another when they leave their cave and explore the hipster environs of the San Francisco Bay Area, and it's clear the siblings have a lot to learn about a technologically driven world. By their side on many adventures are best friend Chloe (the only human character in the cast), fame-obsessed panda Nom Nom, and Charlie, aka Bigfoot.

Grizzly, Panda and Ice Bear stack atop one another when they leave their cave and explore the hipster environs of the San Francisco Bay Area, and it's clear the siblings have a lot to learn about a technologically driven world. By their side on many adventures are best friend Chloe (the only human character in the cast), fame-obsessed panda Nom Nom, and Charlie, aka Bigfoot.

Nowhere is this truer than in Italy, where the shape of your pasta and the sauce you serve it with speak directly to identity, and differentiate each region from the next. In this new series, Stanley's on a culinary quest to explore the connection between the food, the land and the people of the country he loves.

programme.title: Last of the Giants: Wild Fish
programme.desc: Cyril Chauquet and his team are dropped into the middle of the wildest environments on the planet with the sole mission of collecting vital specimens that could save species from extinction. After years of habitat destruction, pollution and commercial pressure, Chauquet and his team are on tight deadlines to make it through the dangerous, rugged terrain and back to civilization. The teams seek out some of the most endangered freshwater goliaths from the Great North of the Americas and the Amazon rainforest, including the armor-plated white sturgeon, the prehistoric pirarucu and the hulking piraiba.

programme.title: Primal Survivor Cutdowns
programme.desc: Wilderness and survival expert Hazen Audel takes treacherous paths in this documentary series. Using his knowledge and skills, Audel sets off on a journey via lesser traveled roads, where the terrain is unstable and the elements are often harsh and unpredictable. Stopping in local communities, Audel speaks to native residents to gather as much information about the area as possible. Following in the footsteps of the Embera tribe, the survival guide goes on a jungle trek through the Darien Gap. In other episodes, he navigates the Arctic Circle with 200 reindeer in tow and crosses crocodile-infested lakes.

Competitors put their skills to the test as they slice through flying watermelons, hack through giant ice blocks, and slice various ropes, tubes, metals, and other objects. programme.desc: You won't hear the phrase "free shipping" uttered in this real-life series. programme.title: Counting Cars
programme.desc: When Rick Harrison and the rest of the "Pawn Stars" gang need to restore a vehicle they're buying, they sometimes turn to Danny "The Count" Koker, who runs Las Vegas auto shop Count's Kustoms. The Count now gets his own half-hour show that showcases his ability to restore and customize classic rides. When he sees a vehicle he wants, whether it's at an auto auction or at a roadside diner, Koker does all he can to acquire it. When successful, he and his team then work to restore and modify the cars and motorcycles to quickly flip them for a profit. programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The forest ranger's house is the only area of human civilization in the middle of untamed wilderness in a vast natural reserve in Canada. When the ranger is away, a bear named Grizzy feels that the ranger's house is his territory, given that bears sit at the top of the food chain. After making his way inside the home, Grizzy takes advantage of all the modern conveniences there, including a comfortable sofa, air conditioning and fully equipped kitchen. He's not alone, though, because a group of small creatures called lemmings also populate the ranger's house when he is away. Because Grizzy and the lemmings are not civilized enough to live together in peace, it becomes an atmosphere of madness when the two sides try to outdo each other with tricks.

programme.title: You Guys Are Couple Goals
programme.desc: Then - You see a hint of jealousy in Riya and Varun's relationship when they were still together. Now - Riya and Varun are "trying" to date other people(while they live together) with hilarious consequences.

programme.title: Mera Spondylitis Phoot Gaya!
programme.desc: An unfortunate accident leads to Riya and Varun realizing the small ways in which their relationship has changed since they were together.

programme.title: Bhen-dad!
programme.desc: A surprise visit from Riya's dad sends Riya, Varun, and Devika in disarray as they have to scramble to make sure he doesn't find out Riya and Varun are not a couple anymore.

programme.title: Mamla Gehra Hai
programme.desc: Riya and Varun are forced to make tough decisions about their future together in the house. To add to their woes, a burglary at the house leaves them deprived of a special possession.

programme.title: Humanize the Ex
programme.desc: To celebrate their stay at the house, the exes - Riya and Varun - decide to have a bonfire party on their lawn. There, they reminisce about their relationship so far.

programme.title: Naye Armaan
programme.desc: Varun turns 30, and Ria is introduced to Anisha. Back in the day, Varun and Ria finally move into a house together.

programme.title: Humesha
programme.desc: Ria decides to go home and tell her parents the truth about Varun and Ria's breakup. Back in the day, Varun and Ria's parents come over as the families meet and make plans for their future.

programme.title: Khwaab
programme.desc: Ria finally admits to having feelings for Varun. Back in the day, we see trouble in Varun and Ria's relationship for the first time.

programme.title: Tanha
programme.desc: Ria starts to look for new houses. Back in the day, Ria and Varun are still dealing with their broken trust, and everything changes.

programme.title: Darmaan
programme.desc: Varun and Ria break up.

programme.title: Hum
programme.desc: Varun and Ria try and make their relationship work.

programme.title: Feels Like Responsibility
programme.desc: As Avi and Lakshay prepare for their "first second house party", Avi's dad decides to drop in for a surprise visit. Meanwhile, Sameer tries to think of different ways to get his unwanted roommate Gandhi to shift to the living room instead. Will their first second party go as planned?

programme.title: Feels Like Give and Take
programme.desc: After weeks of witnessing the boys make a mess of Bancchod Niwas, Sameer tells them to clean up their act. Lakshay's solution is? Get a housekeeper. Meanwhile, Avi, still reeling from his breakup with Mahima, decides to make a "grand gesture", which also inspires Lakshay to get another quirky roommate.

programme.title: Feels Like Summer
programme.desc: As the Delhi heat rises in full force, tempers rise with it. Sameer tries to push himself to perform his poetry for an audience that isn't Lloyd, while Avi tries to drown his sorrows by pretending like he's completely fine. Tensions implode and so do Gandhi's... special parts.

programme.title: Feels Like Finding Yourself
programme.desc: Avi has the greatest plan (his words) to move on and spend time with himself - an Imtiaz Ali-themed tour of Delhi. What could go wrong? Meanwhile, Gandhi's first day of cricket practice doesn't quite go as planned, and Lakshay meets an unexpected acquaintance.

programme.title: Feels Like Family
programme.desc: The boys are at Lakshay's family home for his sister's wedding. As Avi and Gandhi gear up to get lucky, Sameer has a significant revelation. Lakshay, meanwhile, feels out of the loop with his own family, as he feels replaced by his nemesis John. The wedding weekend rages with the promise of chaos and drama.

programme.title: Feels Like Choices
programme.desc: The exam results of last semester are out and Avi's is less than perfect. Afraid to let his dad find out in case he is called back home, Avi cooks up a drastic plan with the help of Sameer and Gandhi. Meanwhile, Lakshay hosts a Fresher's party, where he comes to point of no return. Will the boys make the right choices?

programme.title: Primal
programme.desc: Frank's caught wildlife in the Brazilian jungle including a 400 lbs. White Jaguar. He ships it on the same ship as an arrested assassin. The assassin breaks free and frees the animals.

programme.title: Rogue
programme.desc: Megan Fox is a battle-hardened mercenary in the wilds of Africa whose team has rescued hostages from a gang of murderous rebels and is trying to survive - against both the rebels and a pack of ravenous lions.

programme.title: Feels Like Rock Bottom
programme.desc: A single-take episode right after the events of the party where Avi finds out about Lakshay and Mahima, a fight breaks out between the boys as they deal with their own fears and the problems they have with each other. Will this be the end of their friendship?

programme.title: Feels Like Acceptance
programme.desc: Tensions in the house are at an all-time high. In the middle of this, Vicky Paaji comes home unannounced and starts to stay with the boys. The boys must now team up to kick Vicky Paaji out.

programme.title: Feels Like Hope
programme.desc: As the college fest approaches, Avi and Lakshay are teamed up together which leads to worse consequences for the two of them. Gandhi goes on a journey to find a new passion by participating in the fest, and Sameer pushes himself to face his fear of performing at the fest.

programme.title: The Age of Innocence
programme.desc: Ruhi needs a new phone and a scholarship, but also wants Lucky’s attention. Kenny wants to stand up for his rights but desperately needs help for the same.

programme.title: The Call of the Wild
programme.desc: Ruhi has second thoughts about her choices. Ayesha needs a story at any cost. Aparna is looking for payback. Meanwhile, Aditya makes some progress with the investigation.

programme.title: Great Expectations
programme.desc: Bhati and Gagan face off in a surprisingly close-fought election. Ruhi has a close shave in an outstation exam. Tarush suffers a setback.

programme.title: Brave New World
programme.desc: Ruhi gets a taste of the good life, briefly, before the shit hits the fan. Tarush takes matters into his own hands. Aparna needs to regain control of her show. Bijoy smells a rat.

programme.title: Vanity Fair
programme.desc: Bhati overcommits to a sponsor and faces a logistical nightmare. Tarush follows the breadcrumbs. Everyone crosses paths at the college festival. Well, almost.

programme.title: The Lord of the Flies
programme.desc: Ayesha looks for missing books. Bijoy starts putting things together. Lucky finds himself in trouble. But Nadeem has bigger fish to fry.

programme.title: The Return of the Native
programme.desc: Lucky comforts a guilt-ridden Ruhi. Aarti makes a shocking discovery. Ayesha takes a trip. Bhati faces unexpected resistance. Gagan opens Aparna’s eyes.

programme.title: Bengaluru Hilaa Denge
programme.desc: Pradeep Bhaiyya, an annoying cousin shows up and takes Akhil and Rinzing for a drunken night. Kay sees Aryan making out. Vasudha, frustrated with her subtly sexist boss, heads out to a new age experience and hooks up with a much younger flute player.

programme.title: Braaazilll!!
programme.desc: Vasudha finally manages to have sex. Akhil is struggling to find his groove at the office, ends up meeting an unconventionally attractive girl, and is blown away. By the end, both Vasu and Akhil confront some seriously painful realities of their lives.

programme.title: Waise Wale Bhai Behen
programme.desc: Vasudha and Akhil forget to tie rakhis to each other on Raksha Bandhan. Vasudha loses her patience with her boss Satvik and impulsively resigns from Proficient. Akhil meets a bizarre therapist. He also finds an unlikely yet intriguing match on Kechup.

programme.title: You Guys Are Couple Goals
programme.desc: Then - You see a hint of jealousy in Riya and Varun's relationship when they were still together. Now - Riya and Varun are "trying" to date other people(while they live together) with hilarious consequences.

programme.title: Skyfire
programme.desc: Characters from different backgrounds are thrown together when the plane they're travelling on crashes into the Pacific Ocean. A nightmare fight for survival ensues with the air supply running out and dangers creeping in from all sides.

programme.title: Way Down
programme.desc: A fever dream action film that follows Boy, a deaf person with a vibrant imagination. When his family is murdered, he is trained by a mysterious shaman to repress his childish imagination and become an instrument of death.

programme.title: Feels Like Home
programme.desc: The college fest begins but the boys are divided and on their own journeys. But will the fest bring the boys back together or will this be the end of their home together?

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Dan Short fell in love with cars when he first laid eyes on a 1967 Camaro. He bought a used model as a teenager, but because he couldn't pay someone else to restore it, he learned how to do the work himself. After a stint in the Army, Short decided to make his passion for classic cars his life's work, and FantomWorks was born. Today the Norfolk, Va., company is the largest auto restoration shop in the U.S., and this reality series shows how Short and his team meticulously refurbish some of America's favorite rides. Drama ensues in the form of personality clashes, cost overruns, irate customers and other issues, which are compounded by Short's reputation as a straight shooter who won't accept substandard results.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The forest ranger's house is the only area of human civilization in the middle of untamed wilderness in a vast natural reserve in Canada. When the ranger is away, a bear named Grizzy feels that the ranger's house is his territory, given that bears sit at the top of the food chain. After making his way inside the home, Grizzy takes advantage of all the modern conveniences there, including a comfortable sofa, air conditioning and fully equipped kitchen. He's not alone, though, because a group of small creatures called lemmings also populate the ranger's house when he is away. Because Grizzy and the lemmings are not civilized enough to live together in peace, it becomes an atmosphere of madness when the two sides try to outdo each other with tricks.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The forest ranger's house is the only area of human civilization in the middle of untamed wilderness in a vast natural reserve in Canada. When the ranger is away, a bear named Grizzy feels that the ranger's house is his territory, given that bears sit at the top of the food chain. After making his way inside the home, Grizzy takes advantage of all the modern conveniences there, including a comfortable sofa, air conditioning and fully equipped kitchen. He's not alone, though, because a group of small creatures called lemmings also populate the ranger's house when he is away. Because Grizzy and the lemmings are not civilized enough to live together in peace, it becomes an atmosphere of madness when the two sides try to outdo each other with tricks.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The forest ranger's house is the only area of human civilization in the middle of untamed wilderness in a vast natural reserve in Canada. When the ranger is away, a bear named Grizzy feels that the ranger's house is his territory, given that bears sit at the top of the food chain. After making his way inside the home, Grizzy takes advantage of all the modern conveniences there, including a comfortable sofa, air conditioning and fully equipped kitchen. He's not alone, though, because a group of small creatures called lemmings also populate the ranger's house when he is away. Because Grizzy and the lemmings are not civilized enough to live together in peace, it becomes an atmosphere of madness when the two sides try to outdo each other with tricks.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Dual Survival
programme.desc: Surviving in the wild is not an exact science. Beyond the basics of finding water, food, shelter and eventually help, opinions vary. Two experts tell how they think it's done in this series, as initial episodes feature trained survivalists Dave Canterbury and Cody Lundin demonstrating the skills and creative thinking that can help one cope in tough surroundings. Equipped with minimal gear, the pair are left in remote locations -- an uninhabited island off Nova Scotia, a New Zealand mountaintop, deep in the Everglades, the jungle of Thailand, and the desert of Baja California, to name a few -- where they battle the elements and sometimes each other. Season 3 introduces U.S. Special Ops veteran Joseph Teti to replace Canterbury, in the middle of Season 4 primitive survivalist Matt Graham of Discovery's "Dude, You're Screwed" replaces Lundin, and partway through Season 5 producers forge new partnerships by rotating survival experts as hosts.

programme.title: Dual Survival
programme.desc: Surviving in the wild is not an exact science. Beyond the basics of finding water, food, shelter and eventually help, opinions vary. Two experts tell how they think it's done in this series, as initial episodes feature trained survivalists Dave Canterbury and Cody Lundin demonstrating the skills and creative thinking that can help one cope in tough surroundings. Equipped with minimal gear, the pair are left in remote locations -- an uninhabited island off Nova Scotia, a New Zealand mountaintop, deep in the Everglades, the jungle of Thailand, and the desert of Baja California, to name a few -- where they battle the elements and sometimes each other. Season 3 introduces U.S. Special Ops veteran Joseph Teti to replace Canterbury, in the middle of Season 4 primitive survivalist Matt Graham of Discovery's "Dude, You're Screwed" replaces Lundin, and partway through Season 5 producers forge new partnerships by rotating survival experts as hosts.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: With one quick click the internet allows people to share information like family photos and professional accomplishments, making it easy to ignore or forget that behind clever screen names and witty captions is a dark digital world with real dangers and risks. In hourlong episodes, Web of Lies unravels tragic stories of deception and manipulation triggered by online interactions, from predators lurking behind Facebook profiles to creeps scouring chat rooms for their victims. Re-enactments are buttressed by comments from law enforcement personnel, true-crime experts and psychologists, plus first-person accounts from friends and families of the victims.

programme.title: Betrayed
programme.desc: The filmmaker uncovers shocking true stories of trust shattered by murder, following investigations told from the victims' perspectives.

programme.title: Blood Relatives
programme.desc: From the outside, families seem like harmonious units in loving homes. But you don't necessarily know what secrets families are hiding from the outside world. This series, narrated by actress Brenda Strong, explores families hiding the most extreme of family secrets: murder. Each episode explores a death in a family, unraveling the motives of the family members, all of whom are potential suspects -- and potential victims. Sibling rivalries, disputes over family businesses and infidelity are some of the factors that lead to the families' ultimate betrayals.

programme.title: Haunted Towns
programme.desc: Featured on the Destination America series "Ghost Asylum," the Tennessee Wraith Chasers take their specter-hunting skills on the road to investigate America's most haunted towns. The team -- founder Chris Smith, co-founder Steven McDougal, historian Scott Porter, and trap inventor Brannon Smith -- travels to paranormal hotspots like Salem, Mass., Bisbee, Ariz., and Gettysburg, Pa., to interview witnesses and follow leads to try to pinpoint who is haunting the towns and why. Spooky stories in such places have been passed down through generations. Is it simply folklore, or is it true?

programme.title: True Conviction
programme.desc: Anna-Sigga Nicolazzi examines cases through the eyes of a prosecutor and shares her insights into how the complex threads of a murder investigation come together in the courtroom.

programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, "Redrum" works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim -- and sometimes even the killer -- each story integrates the interviews with stylized re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.title: Disappeared
programme.desc: Here today, gone tomorrow. Thousands of people go missing in the United States each year, leaving behind only a mystery without any clues. Their stories are told in `Disappeared' through the voices of family, friends and investigators trying to solve the case, with each hourlong episode recounting the final stages that led to a person's disappearance. Interviews with experts including psychologists and forensic specialists provide new insights into what may have happened - whether foul play was involved or the subject simply ran away.

programme.title: Ghost Asylum
programme.desc: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers (TWC) are passionate paranormal investigators. The team have a specific niche in the supernatural realm - seeking out activity at asylums, sanitariums and mental hospitals. Unlike other teams, TWC isn't content to conjure up incorporeal beings and collect evidence; it uses traps to capture restless spirits. With common sense and adventurous tendencies, the team either debunk or validate each case it researches, whose venues include hospitals where dead nurses roam the halls and a rehab center that has cries coming from the windows.

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: With one quick click the internet allows people to share information like family photos and professional accomplishments, making it easy to ignore or forget that behind clever screen names and witty captions is a dark digital world with real dangers and risks. In hourlong episodes, Web of Lies unravels tragic stories of deception and manipulation triggered by online interactions, from predators lurking behind Facebook profiles to creeps scouring chat rooms for their victims. Re-enactments are buttressed by comments from law enforcement personnel, true-crime experts and psychologists, plus first-person accounts from friends and families of the victims.

programme.title: Betrayed
programme.desc: The filmmaker uncovers shocking true stories of trust shattered by murder, following investigations told from the victims' perspectives.

programme.title: Blood Relatives
programme.desc: From the outside, families seem like harmonious units in loving homes. But you don't necessarily know what secrets families are hiding from the outside world. This series, narrated by actress Brenda Strong, explores families hiding the most extreme of family secrets: murder. Each episode explores a death in a family, unraveling the motives of the family members, all of whom are potential suspects -- and potential victims. Sibling rivalries, disputes over family businesses and infidelity are some of the factors that lead to the families' ultimate betrayals.

programme.title: Haunted Towns
programme.desc: Featured on the Destination America series "Ghost Asylum," the Tennessee Wraith Chasers take their specter-hunting skills on the road to investigate America's most haunted towns. The team -- founder Chris Smith, co-founder Steven McDougal, historian Scott Porter, and trap inventor Brannon Smith -- travels to paranormal hotspots like Salem, Mass., Bisbee, Ariz., and Gettysburg, Pa., to interview witnesses and follow leads to try to pinpoint who is haunting the towns and why. Spooky stories in such places have been passed down through generations. Is it simply folklore, or is it true?

programme.title: True Conviction
programme.desc: Anna-Sigga Nicolazzi examines cases through the eyes of a prosecutor and shares her insights into how the complex threads of a murder investigation come together in the courtroom.

programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, "Redrum" works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim -- and sometimes even the killer -- each story integrates the interviews with stylized re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.title: Disappeared
programme.desc: Here today, gone tomorrow. Thousands of people go missing in the United States each year, leaving behind only a mystery without any clues. Their stories are told in `Disappeared' through the voices of family, friends and investigators trying to solve the case, with each hourlong episode recounting the final stages that led to a person's disappearance. Interviews with experts including psychologists and forensic specialists provide new insights into what may have happened - whether foul play was involved or the subject simply ran away.

programme.title: Ghost Asylum
programme.desc: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers (TWC) are passionate paranormal investigators. The team have a specific niche in the supernatural realm - seeking out activity at asylums, sanitariums and mental hospitals. Unlike other teams, TWC isn't content to conjure up incorporeal beings and collect evidence; it uses traps to capture restless spirits. With common sense and adventurous tendencies, the team either debunk or validate each case it researches, whose venues include hospitals where dead nurses roam the halls and a rehab center that has cries coming from the windows.

programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Dual Survival
programme.desc: Surviving in the wild is not an exact science. Beyond the basics of finding water, food, shelter and eventually help, opinions vary. Two experts tell how they think it's done in this series, as initial episodes feature trained survivalists Dave Canterbury and Cody Lundin demonstrating the skills and creative thinking that can help one cope in tough surroundings. Equipped with minimal gear, the pair are left in remote locations -- an uninhabited island off Nova Scotia, a New Zealand mountaintop, deep in the Everglades, the jungle of Thailand, and the desert of Baja California, to name a few -- where they battle the elements and sometimes each other. Season 3 introduces U.S. Special Ops veteran Joseph Teti to replace Canterbury, in the middle of Season 4 primitive survivalist Matt Graham of Discovery's "Dude, You're Screwed" replaces Lundin, and partway through Season 5 producers forge new partnerships by rotating survival experts as hosts.

programme.title: We Bare Bears
programme.desc: Three brother bears awkwardly attempt to find their place in civilized society, whether they're looking for food, trying to make human friends, or scheming to become famous on the internet. Grizzly, Panda and Ice Bear stack atop one another when they leave their cave and explore the hipster environs of the San Francisco Bay Area, and it's clear the siblings have a lot to learn about a technologically driven world. By their side on many adventures are best friend Chloe (the only human character in the cast), fame-obsessed panda Nom Nom, and Charlie, aka Bigfoot.

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: With one quick click the internet allows people to share information like family photos and professional accomplishments, making it easy to ignore or forget that behind clever screen names and witty captions is a dark digital world with real dangers and risks. In hourlong episodes, Web of Lies unravels tragic stories of deception and manipulation triggered by online interactions, from predators lurking behind Facebook profiles to creeps scouring chat rooms for their victims. Re-enactments are buttressed by comments from law enforcement personnel, true-crime experts and psychologists, plus first-person accounts from friends and families of the victims.

programme.title: Betrayed
programme.desc: The filmmaker uncovers shocking true stories of trust shattered by murder, following investigations told from the victims' perspectives.

programme.title: Blood Relatives
programme.desc: From the outside, families seem like harmonious units in loving homes. But you don't necessarily know what secrets families are hiding from the outside world. This series, narrated by actress Brenda Strong, explores families hiding the most extreme of family secrets: murder. Each episode explores a death in a family, unraveling the motives of the family members, all of whom are potential suspects -- and potential victims. Sibling rivalries, disputes over family businesses and infidelity are some of the factors that lead to the families' ultimate betrayals.

programme.title: Haunted Towns
programme.desc: Featured on the Destination America series "Ghost Asylum," the Tennessee Wraith Chasers take their specter-hunting skills on the road to investigate America's most haunted towns. The team -- founder Chris Smith, co-founder Steven McDougal, historian Scott Porter, and trap inventor Brannon Smith -- travels to paranormal hotspots like Salem, Mass., Bisbee, Ariz., and Gettysburg, Pa., to interview witnesses and follow leads to try to pinpoint who is haunting the towns and why. Spooky stories in such places have been passed down through generations. Is it simply folklore, or is it true?

programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, "Redrum" works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim -- and sometimes even the killer -- each story integrates the interviews with stylized re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.title: Disappeared
programme.desc: Here today, gone tomorrow. Thousands of people go missing in the United States each year, leaving behind only a mystery without any clues. Their stories are told in `Disappeared' through the voices of family, friends and investigators trying to solve the case, with each hourlong episode recounting the final stages that led to a person's disappearance. Interviews with experts including psychologists and forensic specialists provide new insights into what may have happened - whether foul play was involved or the subject simply ran away.

programme.title: Ghost Asylum
programme.desc: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers (TWC) are passionate paranormal investigators. The team have a specific niche in the supernatural realm - seeking out activity at asylums, sanitariums and mental hospitals. Unlike other teams, TWC isn't content to conjure up incorporeal beings and collect evidence; it uses traps to capture restless spirits. With common sense and adventurous tendencies, the team either debunk or validate each case it researches, whose venues include hospitals where dead nurses roam the halls and a rehab center that has cries coming from the windows.

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: With one quick click the internet allows people to share information like family photos and professional accomplishments, making it easy to ignore or forget that behind clever screen names and witty captions is a dark digital world with real dangers and risks. In hourlong episodes, Web of Lies unravels tragic stories of deception and manipulation triggered by online interactions, from predators lurking behind Facebook profiles to creeps scouring chat rooms for their victims. Re-enactments are buttressed by comments from law enforcement personnel, true-crime experts and psychologists, plus first-person accounts from friends and families of the victims.

Spooky stories in such places have been passed down through generations. Is it simply folklore, or is it true?

programme.title: Food Factory
programme.desc: Food Network Canada presents this eye-opening series featuring food factories. Each episode offers a behind-the-scenes view of production lines across the country to find out how some of the most-popular food items are really made. In what some call a fascinating world, the manufacturing and technology that is being used in factories simplifies how the country gets its food.

Grizzly, Panda and Ice Bear stack atop one another when they leave their cave and explore the hipster environs of the San Francisco Bay Area, and it's clear the siblings have a lot to learn about a technologically driven world. By their side on many adventures are best friend Chloe (the only human character in the cast), fame-obsessed panda Nom Nom, and Charlie, aka Bigfoot.

programme.desc: This is a UK version of the popular US series `Say Yes to the Dress', the show where wives-to-be are united with their perfect bridal dress. Set in Essex, the Confetti and Lace bridal boutique welcomes customers from all over the UK as they seek to find the wedding dress of their dreams. On hand with their expert advice is store owner and wedding dress designer, Christine Dando and creator of Princess Diana's infamous wedding dress, David Emanuel. The pair do everything in their power to make the day a special experience for each unique bride who also shares their personal anecdotes with the crew.

programme.title: Descending
programme.desc: In this 13-part documentary series, hosts Scott Wilson and Ellis Emmett descend beneath the surface to explore the three-quarters of the planet that is covered in water. Each episode features a new location, where Wilson and Emmett discover all that the area has to offer. They explore the cultures of the local people, share stories of human triumph and tragedy, and connect the world on land to the one in the sea. With each dive into the unknown, they encounter creatures and sights that most people will never get to experience.

programme.desc:
Four girls are kidnapped while returning from a rave party. They were drunk and driving rashly. They wake up to find themselves tied up in a secluded and unkempt bunglow. There is a fifth girl who has been tortured since long. Brutally beaten. The torture begins for these 4 girls. The man and woman who keep them hostage have CCTVs installed in the room where these girls are kept. Thus whenever they try to run away, or make any move are captured back. These goes on for days and then one day the kidnapper kills one of the girl's and feeds her to his dog, as she finds out that her husband has also been killed by the same man.
Later, the woman assisting the kidnapper reveals his story to these girls. The kidnapper had a sister, and she gets killed by a rash driving. Thus anyone who is driving irresponsibly will have to pay the price.
Towards the end these 3 girls manage to escape and reach their homes, only to discover that the kidnapper was actually one of the leading psychiatrist and was requested by their parents to treat the daughters from alcohol and drug abuse and addiction.
Since the traditional methods were tried earlier and lack of cooperation from patients yield no results, thus they reached out to this doctor.
Hence the doctor along with his colleagues & the two friends (whom were thought to have been killed) devise a 21 days treatment plan & everything was just part of it.
